title: Bit questions
description:
Answer three questions about a number in `rdi`, each with one bit-scanning instruction:

| Function | Result |
|---|---|
| `ones(x)` | how many bits are 1 |
| `lowest_one(x)` | the position of the lowest 1 bit, or −1 when x is 0 |
| `log2_floor(x)` | the position of the highest 1 bit (⌊log₂ x⌋), or −1 when x is 0 |

starter.solution.asm:
ones:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

lowest_one:
        mov     rax, -1
        ret

log2_floor:
        mov     rax, -1
        ret

solution.solution.asm:
ones:
        popcnt  rax, rdi
        ret

lowest_one:
        mov     rax, -1
        test    rdi, rdi
        jz      .done
        tzcnt   rax, rdi
.done:  ret

log2_floor:
        mov     rax, -1
        test    rdi, rdi
        jz      .done
        bsr     rax, rdi
.done:  ret

hints: `popcnt`, `tzcnt` and `bsr` each answer one question in a single instruction. Check for 0 first where the answer must be −1.
unitTests:
test "ones"
    ones(0) == 0
    ones(88) == 3
    ones(-1) == 64
test "lowest one"
    lowest_one(88) == 3
    lowest_one(1) == 0
    lowest_one(0) == -1
    lowest_one(0x8000000000000000) == 63
test "log2"
    log2_floor(1) == 0
    log2_floor(1000) == 9
    log2_floor(1024) == 10
    log2_floor(0) == -1

grading.unitTests:
